review: Four normally admitted default Pro Installer reference images, 10/10 in the default state. Reviewer did not implement the mounted product or edit its images. The public source and generated website were compared with the four original accepted images and the latest consolidated product.

admission.evidence: Four independent browser probes loaded the real package through normal selection, verified the admitted Blob and computed its digest. Their raw diagnostic erroneously expected the distribution filename. Matching their observed name against the selected catalog URL, and their observed browser hash and byte count against the release binary, verifies the actual product identity.
